name: Eranium Transit
notes:
We are the new-generation connectivity partner, fully privately owned and funded. We have built a next-generation connectivity fabric across major metros like Amsterdam, Frankfurt, Paris, Vienna. [Read more](https://www.eranium.io/about) about our initiative.

We also operate the [ERA-IX](https://www.era-ix.com/) internet exchange platform. AS35133 is our IP transit product that aggregates T1 connectivity and is available on our fabric.

We maintain an open-peering policy, and we exclusively peer with the ERA-IX Route Servers.
